_notes.producer: execution/dashboard_export.py build_state(); the page and dashboard_tui.py render the same dict
_notes.accounts: engine account first (traded=true); others come from ALPACA_ACCOUNTS and are watched only. An account with `error` has null account/stats.
_notes.stats: profit_factor / expectancy / win_rate / trades_closed come from decision_logic and exist only for the traded account (null for watched). premium_mtd = option sells minus option buys this month, from broker fills.
_notes.positions.kind: csp | cc | short_call | long_put | long_call | stock
_notes.positions.action: the position_management rule the mark currently sits in: hold | close_50 | roll | force_close | stop | quarantine. The dashboard's reading, not the manager's queue.
_notes.modules.status: ok | late | stale | idle (market-hours module, market closed) | blocked. Scheduled modules carry last_run / expected / missed; interval modules carry last_seen / interval_s.
_notes.market: from Alpaca /v2/clock, never a local clock
_notes.events: newest first, last 50 insights with same-source bursts collapsed
